capture.title: The Last Cup
capture.caption: Light hits a paper cup on a wooden table.
capture.alt: Black and white photo of a single paper cup on a grained wooden table in a dark room with a sliver of light from above.

chitta.title: The Red Cap
chitta.caption: A man in a red beanie leans over a metal tray on a stone ledge.
chitta.alt: A person wearing a red cap and brown jacket bends over a small tray of food on a stone block next to a grey car.

courage-3.title: Grain And Void
courage-3.caption: Split wood holds a deep, vertical fissure.
courage-3.alt: Black and white close-up of a weathered, textured piece of wood diagonally crossing a black background.

fate.title: River At Dusk
fate.caption: Glasses reflect the orange light of the horizon.
fate.alt: Side profile of a person wearing glasses looking at a river under a dark orange sunset sky.

flowers.title: Transit Hall
flowers.caption: Magenta petals against a polished stone floor.
flowers.alt: Four bright pink artificial flowers in a pot in the foreground of a long, empty tiled corridor.

globe.title: Glass Sphere
globe.caption: Light bends through a pitted glass ball on a wooden surface.
globe.alt: A small, textured glass sphere resting on a ribbed wooden surface, lit from behind against a black background.

howler.title: Night Watch
howler.caption: The dog sits against a pale wall in the dark.
howler.alt: Silhouette of a dog sitting on a dark pavement at night, facing a white wall and a distant street lamp.

induction.title: Glass And Flame
induction.caption: Light bends through two glass spheres on a wooden surface.
induction.alt: Two glass spheres resting on a light-colored wood grain surface against a black background, one containing a bright orange flame.

journey.title: Rear View
journey.caption: Three men sit in the back of a white pickup truck on a narrow road.
journey.alt: The back of a white pickup truck carrying three men and cargo, driving away on a paved road lined with green trees under a blue sky.

its.title: The Workshop Row
its.caption: A pink price tag hangs from the hand of a goddess.
its.alt: A line of painted deity statues under a bamboo roof with a numbered price tag in the foreground.

laughter.title: Discarded Form
laughter.caption: Paint peels from a smiling face in the dirt.
laughter.alt: A broken doll head and arm lie amidst dark soil, dry leaves, and debris.

reminder.title: Stone And Banyan
reminder.caption: Green cloth hangs behind a seated stone figure.
reminder.alt: A stone statue of a seated Buddha on a pedestal, positioned against a green fabric backdrop with banyan roots hanging above.

snoop-dogg.title: The Watchman
snoop-dogg.caption: A red and white collar sits loose on the neck.
snoop-dogg.alt: Close-up of a brown and white beagle dog wearing a red and blue collar, standing in a concrete yard before a corrugated metal shed.

view.title: Railway Yard
view.caption: Rust red and blue cars sit on parallel tracks.
view.alt: High angle view of a train yard with red freight cars and blue passenger coaches under a bright blue sky with one large cloud.
